    Bipartite quivers from a graph and a colouring #

    For a simple graph G and a colouring c (true = source), BQ G c has an arrow a → b for each edge with c a = true, c b = false. For a proper colouring its underlying graph is G; it has no path of length two and is acyclic. Every proper colouring of D̃ₘ₊₄ gives a representation-infinite path category, and a diagram of morphisms indexed by it which avoids τ and satisfies the zigzag conditions contradicts minimality (RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_bq_diagram).
